plan.change_summary:
The large rectangular photo pasted over the wardrobe is a TEMPORARY IDENTITY GUIDE ONLY. Remove that entire rectangle, its forest background, and its black coat. Reconstruct the exact hotel wardrobe underneath it: same dark brown wood, same frame, same right-side hinges, same brass knob, same perspective, and the same nearly closed door geometry as the surrounding source scene. The wardrobe door must remain almost fully closed, with only a very narrow vertical black slit along its left edge, approximately 18–25 pixels wide in this 1535 px image. Do not open the door wider.

Inside the slit, replace the previous generic pig head with the EXACT mask design shown in the temporary guide photo. This is a human wearing a mask, not an actual pig and not a different pig-mask design. Preserve these non-negotiable identity traits from the guide: smooth pale flesh-pink oval mask; very high rounded bald forehead; mostly clean lightly scuffed rubber/flesh surface with only subtle tiny gray marks, not thick black mold crust; asymmetric outward ears, with the viewer-left ear smaller and slightly folded and the viewer-right ear larger and taller; two very small circular deeply recessed eye holes set relatively low; pale gray human iris visible inside the one exposed eye hole; broad short cylindrical pink snout with two large round black nostrils; tiny slightly open mouth immediately below the snout; soft fleshy jaw folds. The eye-hole size, ear silhouette, forehead height, snout width/length, nostril spacing, and pale pink color must visibly match the guide, not merely suggest a pig.

Push the masked figure deep behind the door. Through the narrow slit show only a cropped fragment of the official mask: a small slice of one ear, exactly one tiny round eye hole with its pale human eye, and part of the broad short snout with at least one dark nostril. Never show the full mask, both eyes, full head, full face, or readable facial silhouette. Beneath it show at most a near-black hair-thin hint of an unnaturally long, severely emaciated bare neck; no shoulder mass, chest, ribs, arms, hands, clothing, pelvis, buttocks, or genitals. The figure is motionless and hidden, not emerging.

Keep the wardrobe interior nearly black and use only faint warm rim light consistent with the room. Preserve all pixels outside the locked selection exactly. Do not alter the bed, bathroom, lamp, walls, TV, table, camera, grading, sharpness, grain, or room lighting. The result must remain photorealistic subtle survival horror, frightening because the exact referenced mask is barely visible.
preserve_contract: Preserve architecture, large furniture, object placement, lighting direction, and mood outside the requested change.
Keep all pixels outside the selected mask visually stable unless the instruction says this is a global change.

guidance: Use the supplied edit mask as the only editable region.
